name: Title index
does: A work by any spelling of its title → the library's copy, linked

name: Work dossier
does: What a book is, who wrote it, why it matters, from library passages

name: Keyword search (BM25)
does: Exact words and terms, fast; narrowed by tradition, author or work

name: Verbatim lead
does: A passage that contains the words in order leads the results

name: Phrase semantic search
does: Phrase-level vectors: the closest wording, with its span

name: HyPE concept search
does: The questions each passage answers, matched to the reader's question

name: Planned library search
does: Jev plan → scoped multi-layer search, narrow then relax, authority-ranked

name: Shelf presets
does: Search one named shelf: scripture, authoritative interpretation, law, history, prayers

name: Rerank
does: Re-order candidates for the question (cross-encoder today; a Jev rerank task proposed)
where: api/lib/reranker.js:rerank (Voyage); Jev rerank task: to build

name: Read around
does: Paragraphs before and after a hit; refuses copyrighted books

name: Source hunt
does: A quotation → published source, the original tablet, works that quote it

name: Trace to primary
does: A letter, scholar or compilation → the primary passages it rests on

name: Reference parser
does: 'John 3:16', 'surah 2:255', 'Gleanings CXXV', 'Hidden Words Arabic 5' → the paragraph
where: api/lib/refs/cite.js:parseCitation, refs/schemes.js; respond.js:hiddenWordRef. Bible, Qur'an, Gita: to build

name: Find original
does: English passage → aligned Arabic/Persian original + linked translations

name: Find translation
does: Original text → existing translations (authorized, published, Phelps provisional)

name: CTAI word study
does: Shoghi Effendi's renderings of a word or root, with counts and paired passages
where: api/lib/assistant/ctai-term.js:resolveTerm, ctaiTerm. Passage rendering + translation guide: to build

name: Original term in passage
does: The original word behind an English word in one paragraph

name: Glossary / concept lexicon
does: Short meaning of a term, name or foreign word, with a proof paragraph
where: api/lib/search/concepts.js:loadLexicon, proofParagraph (concept lexicon); general religious glossary: to build

name: People record
does: Who someone was: biography record and cited claims

name: Name resolver
does: Which bearer of a name or which work a message means (bare name = most prominent)

name: People search
does: Who did X, members of a group, who met whom, each with cited claims

name: Dated events
does: Dated facts with source passages, for timelines across people and events
where: api/lib/bio-timeline.js:selectFacts (one person only); cross-entity: to build

name: Prepared collection
does: Prepared knowledge: topic research collections (checked passage sets for common topics); book research dossiers are the Work dossier
where: api/lib/deep-research.js:checkDeepResearch, getDeepResearchQuotes (per canonical question; topic collections to build)

name: Prayers by occasion
does: Prayer shelf indexed by occasion and need

name: Guidance by date
does: House of Justice messages by date and topic, with what supersedes what
where: api/lib/letters/letters.js (letter lookup by author/date); supersession index: to build

name: Holy-day calendar
does: Which Feast or Holy Day is next, and its theme

name: Checked fact sheets
does: Fixed, sourced facts for recurring questions (no clergy, how one enrols, how the Faith is organised)

name: Library counts
does: Live counts of traditions, works, languages

name: Web, labelled
does: The open web as a LEAD or for what a library can't hold; always labelled

name: Last turn's evidence
does: The passages, links and claims of the previous reply; 'that one' resolved to an item
where: respond.js:referenceOf, evidenceOf; search-plan.js:followUpAsks. Item-level refer-back: to build

name: Reader card
does: ~50-word profile of the reader: language, level, traditions, interests, place in a book
where: assistant/reading.js keeps reading position only; card + log: to build

name: Citation gate
does: After writing: drops any quote not in the passages, links every quote, fixes speakers

name: Format chooser
does: Picks the answer template from question + evidence profile + channel

name: Jev: request type
does: Message + thread → lead type and also-types (A1–H2), new or follow-up
where: triage.js KINDS (coarse kinds) + search-plan.js:planSearch today; A1–H2 decision: to build (Jev is given the type list and the thread, never trained)

name: Jev decision point
does: found? enough? source or quoter? answers or only mentions?
where: api/lib/systemone.js:ask (infra exists; each decision gets the context it needs; never trained)

name: Light LLM: extract
does: Pull the quote, names, author, work and search terms out of a message

name: Light LLM: recast
does: Rewrite a vague or colloquial question into one a concept search can answer

name: Light LLM: plan
does: Split an assignment into sub-themes and shelves, shown to the reader

name: Writing model
does: Writes every answer once, from data + format, in Anís's voice and for the reader card; a light writing model for lookups; never decides what to search

name: Research agent
does: One model loop over the library tools; the fallback for every strategy

name: Deep-research job
does: Multi-round research with a shown plan; emailed report
